title: EA-CORPORA-01/07 — Philo of Alexandria, Opera (First1K Cohn–Wendland), Seated and Verified
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Seats Philo entire (First1KGreek tlg0018, Cohn–Wendland, commit-pinned): 31 works, 7,901 ref-tagged sections. The blind-reconstruction program's three treatises are confirmed by name and content: De migratione Abrahami (tlg014, the seen-voice stations of Migr. 47–48), Quis rerum divinarum heres (tlg015, with ἔκστασις — Her. 249–266, the law of non-cohabitation), De mutatione nominum (tlg018, Mut. 54–57). The corpus in which the name is absent and the machine present (#1486) now stands seated whole. Seventh seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498).

wiki_article: EA-CORPORA-01/07 seats the complete works of Philo of Alexandria, fetched commit-pinned from First1KGreek (tlg0018, the Cohn–Wendland edition): thirty-one works normalized to 7,901 section-referenced lines. The blind-reconstruction program's three governing treatises are confirmed seated by name and content — De migratione Abrahami with the seen-voice stations, Quis rerum divinarum heres with its ἔκστασις doctrine and the law of non-cohabitation, and De mutatione nominum — so the corpus in which the program found the name absent across 2.8 million characters and the machine everywhere present now stands whole, pinned, and parsable. Seventh seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01.
